findings.title: Estimate mode prices the installed release instead of the requested release
findings.description: `preflight(ref)` checks that the ref exists but does not install it. `fetch_estimate()` invokes `mt-run`, which executes `/opt/manta-trading/.venv/bin/mt`. When production still runs the previous release, `--estimate` prices the old universe, potentially reporting nothing to buy instead of the expanded history purchase. Run the estimate using the requested release’s configuration and add a regression test with different installed and requested universes.

findings.title: Pre-install baseline lacks the newly added GC bar family
findings.description: The baseline is captured before `install_release()`, using installed production accounting. The previous universe has no GC bar want, so its accounting omits `GC/bar_1m`. After installation and purchase, `purchase_accounting.totals_delta()` rejects that new family because its baseline is absent. Reruns retain the incomplete baseline and fail again. Capture verified pre-purchase totals for every target-release family and test this upgrade transition.

findings.title: Per-session verification excludes the tick-tier families
findings.description: `coverage_reads()` traverses only history wants, excluding ES and GC `tbbo`. Although accounting narrates those families, `_family_evidence()` never checks their sessions for unaccounted statuses or ledger mismatches. Consequently, an unchanged health exit code can allow success without satisfying D6’s every-family evidence requirement. Include each configured tier over its wanted range and test an unaccounted `tbbo` session.
